frame: F1, mm: +x forward (bill tip ~+137), +y wearer's left, +z up (01_frame)
status: proposed: pending the physical fit test

conventions.uAxis: reads left-to-right as seen from outside the hat; for the labels, as seen by someone inside the hat looking at the band (the labels are on the wearer's right, so the strap opening is on the reader's right)
conventions.vAxis: up (toward the crown with the hat worn)
conventions.normal: the visible face's normal (outward for the crown spots, into the hat for the labels) = u x v
conventions.printUv: u = x/W, v = 1 - y/H on TEXCOORD_0 (die-stage pixels x right, y down)
conventions.trueScale: area-weighted median per-triangle scale = 1, so 1 in on the hat = pxPerInch px

patch.method: step-04 proxy carried onto smooth_k60; LSCM + 20 ARAP iterations; true scale = area-weighted median per-triangle scale; u right / v up; full-res vertices by their proxy triangle's barycentrics; uv_mm is about the rect centre

geometricMax._noteRuler: surface length along each maximum's mid-lines (u, v) over its chart length, minus 1, in %

limitedByKey.eyelet_column: the line under a back eyelet
limitedByKey.band_end: the band end at the opening
limitedByKey.flat: curvature: printed flat it would stretch past mean 1 % / p99 3 %
